content:
This week was all about making DevOps Open Agent more practical for real-world enterprise environments.

When you're building an AI-powered DevOps platform, it's easy to create flashy demos. The hard part is solving the problems that platform teams actually face every day.

Here's what we shipped this week:

✅ Multi-AWS Account Support

Investigate resources across multiple AWS accounts using STS AssumeRole. No more switching credentials or jumping between AWS consoles.

✅ Prometheus + Grafana Integration

Bring live metrics directly into AI investigations. Instead of relying only on logs, the agent can now use data from your existing observability stack to make better troubleshooting decisions.

✅ AWS Bedrock Integration

You can now use Amazon Bedrock as your LLM provider. If your organization already uses AWS, you can leverage the same credentials and security model without introducing another external AI service.

✅ LLM Cost Visibility

AI is powerful, but it also costs money. We've added usage tracking, estimated costs, daily budgets, and Slack/Microsoft Teams alerts so teams can keep AI spending under control.

❤️ The community keeps growing!

📌 52 GitHub Stars (we crossed the 50-star milestone!)

📌 2,501 Visitors in the last 14 days

📌 255 Repository Clones

A huge thank you to everyone who has starred the project or simply tried it out. Your feedback is helping shape the future of this project. 🙏

If you're interested in building or exploring an open-source AI platform for DevOps, SRE, and Platform Engineering, I'd love to hear your thoughts.
